story: In WYA2018 (2018), Sze Ham Chan is a co-author in the middle of the author list; the paper is a study in human cells that mapped 828 lysosome-associated proteins and found that NUFIP1 moves to autophagosomes and lysosomes and helps bring ribosomes there for breakdown when mTORC1 is switched off.
